D.tier: Queued, roster and office levers only

D.t: Sam Liccardo leads by 63.5 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 171,037 votes; a one point swing is about 1,348 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +58.8 and D +68.0. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$2.2M cash against $400. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
